To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the dynamic response of slab track system is influenced by the track structure stiffness and track stiffness transition, and it can be effectively controlled by changing the track structure parameters and transition parameters.

(1) the slab track structure has a significant effect on the dynamic behavior of the slab track; (2) the stiffness of the transition has a significant influence on the dynamic behavior, and the effect is greater with an increase in train speed; (3) the dynamic behavior of track transitions from conventional ballast tracks to slab tracks can be improved by changing the track stiffness in transition, and the effect can be further improved by smoothing the stiffness of the track in the transition.
slab tracks are a viable alternative to ballast for high speed rail.
